provider.name: Global Biodiversity Information Facility
provider.organization_type: global biodiversity occurrence, checklist, taxonomy, dataset, publishing, collection, literature, map, and data-access infrastructure
provider.description: GBIF is an international network and data infrastructure that provides open access to biodiversity data supplied by institutions and publishers worldwide. It indexes occurrence records, sampling events, taxonomic checklists, metadata-only datasets, scientific collections, institutions, literature, maps, downloads, and derived datasets.
institutional_context: Biodiversity data publishers, museums, collections, research institutions, and citizen-science networks

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting GBIF documentation, occurrence and taxonomic guidance, dataset publishing workflows, APIs, downloads, Darwin Core and IPT materials, vocabularies, data quality, maps, collections, citations, licenses, terms, and organizational context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: GBIF, its Secretariat, participating nodes, publishers, dataset owners, and cited standards remain authoritative for data records, APIs, downloads, taxonomic interpretations, licenses, citations, terms, and contact information.

notes: Verify current API versions, endpoint paths, authentication rules, request limits, and pagination behavior.
Distinguish synchronous public read APIs from queued authenticated occurrence downloads.
Capture predicates, facets, field names, issue codes, taxon keys, dataset keys, UUIDs, and deprecations.

Capture exact dataset-level and record-level license wording before normalizing rights metadata.
Separate occurrence metadata, taxonomic content, media, maps, literature, hosted portals, software, and downloaded files.
Preserve dataset key, publisher, dataset citation, download DOI, rights holder, license URI, source URL, and access date.
Do not assume GBIF aggregation grants broader rights than the original publisher or media-provider license.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
GBIF portal paths, API versions, OpenAPI pages, vocabulary URLs, registry pages, and hosted-portal documentation may change; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every occurrence, species page, dataset, publisher, institution, collection, country, literature record, API result, or map tile when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store GBIF usernames, passwords, API credentials, cookies, OAuth tokens, or session credentials in this JSON file.
Occurrence records, taxonomic content, media, datasets, literature, maps, APIs, downloads, and software may carry different rights.
Always preserve occurrence identifier, GBIF ID, dataset key, publisher, taxon key, issues, license, download DOI, citation, access date, and source provenance.
